requirements.description: User wants the building located near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics) for a residential senior care facility. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.

The user explicitly requires a minimum gross floor area of 1,600 sqm, so this is applied as a >= surface filter. The 30-person capacity is not converted into a surface threshold because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Energy class and proximity to healthcare are outside the reference columns and are ignored here.

The user prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes all classes from A1 to D. Area (1,600 sqm), capacity (30 people), RSA use, and proximity to healthcare are not energy columns and are not filtered here.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 1600 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND healthcare >= 75 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: surface_area >= 1600; within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine_km on latitude/longitude; healthcare >= 75; energy_class in A1–D. Conditions are ordered from strictest (area, location radius) to softest (healthcare proximity, energy class). Results are ordered by distance from the coordinate. Property type and capacity were not in the extracted requirements, so they are not filtered.
